summary: ConnectOne Bancorp filed an 8-K solely to furnish an investor presentation under Item 8.01. The filing does not announce any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. It is a routine current report with no special-situation event. No deal terms are disclosed because no transaction is announced.
